meta.name: Live Drop
meta.notes: Charcoal studio feed stays fixed; --c-primary only drives live graphics (channel ident, LIVE bug, lower-third bars, INTACT stamp, seal, active camera switch) with --c-on-primary text, and readable accents use a primary/white mix so any colour works.

issues: Promise certificate: the 'CAM 3 · ARCHIVE' monitor rendered as a large black hole on both brands (lazy or broken story image with no fallback)
Heats with only one or two categories (Brinks) left a single tiny thumbnail floating in a huge empty segment
Mobile: the monitor wall became one endless single column of giant square tiles, about 8 screen heights of scrolling
Mobile: the scoreboard stacked into a tall single-column list that kills the 'ticker board' feel
Hero lower third and T-minus block sit a little small for the size of the frame, but the broadcast metaphor, tower stage and scoreboard are strong and survive both primaries
fixed: Archive monitor now has an SMPTE test card plus brand-colour bars and an initials ident behind the photo, scanlines on top, eager loading and onerror removal, so it is never an empty black box
One or two heats now become wide 'start line' cards: 16:10 image, huge condensed name, a primary rule on top, a 'Heat 01 · on the start line' label and an 'All results →' button
Mobile monitor wall is now 2-up with smaller camera labels, a tighter mini lower third and verdict chip
Mobile scoreboard is now a 2-up grid with a full-width header row, which reads like a real broadcast results board
